summary.one_liner: The getcursor/cursor GitHub repository is an issue-tracker landing page for the Cursor editor, with a very short README that points users to the website and community forum rather than containing source code.
summary.what_it_does: The README is minimal and does not describe the product in detail. It asks users to post bug reports and feature requests on the community forum rather than as GitHub issues. It says to download Cursor from the project website and links to a features page, though the link targets are blank in the text. It includes a security section asking people not to report vulnerabilities through public issues and to email security-reports@cursor.com instead. No source code, build steps, or technical architecture are described in the README.
how_to_run: Download Cursor from the project website (link referenced in the README)
Post bugs or feature requests on the community forum
notable: Serves as the public feedback hub for Cursor, with bugs and feature requests directed to the forum
Security policy asks reporters to use private email (security-reports@cursor.com) instead of public issues
README contains no source code or build instructions
caveats: Repository is an issue-only hub; the README does not describe the codebase or how to build it
Resource links in the README are empty, so the download and features URLs are not given in the text
Feedback is directed to the community forum rather than GitHub issues
